title: Effect of missing or incorrect information
bodyText: . Except as otherwise provided in section 490:9-337, a certificate of title or other record required or authorized by this chapter shall be effective even if it contains incorrect information or does not contain required information.
bodyHtml: [§200A-18]  Effect of missing or incorrect information.  Except as otherwise provided in section 490:9-337, a certificate of title or other record required or authorized by this chapter shall be effective even if it contains incorrect information or does not contain required information. [L 2018, c 46, pt of §1]
